title: UAAP: NUNS, FEU-D still unbeaten in junior high school hoops
summary: National University Nazareth School overwhelmed UP Integrated School, 100-45, to remain unbeaten in the UAAP Season 89 16-and-under basketball tournament, Wednesday at the Mall of Asia Arena.
